newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Yeltsin, in sanatorium, to meet chief-of-staff.
newsitem.headline: Yeltsin, in sanatorium, to meet chief-of-staff.

text.p: Russian President Boris Yeltsin will meet chief-of-staff Anatoly Chubais on Thursday, the Kremlin press office said.

"President Yeltsin will hold his regular weekly meeting with his head of administration, Anatoly Chubais, in the first half of the day in the Barvikha sanatorium," a Kremlin spokesman said. The president was also working with documents.
Yeltsin, who spent over three weeks in hospital while doctors prepared the ground for an operation on his heart, moved to the Barvikha sanatorium outside Moscow last weekend.
The operation is due in the next two months.
